job_description:
US-E-Consulting Services - AI & E - EaaS - Consultant, Strategy Growth & Transformation - FY27

Position Summary

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses.

Work You'll Do

As a Consultant in our AI & Engineering Engineering-as-a-Service team, you will work on end-to-end IT transformation projects for major consulting clients; collaborate with cross-functional engineering and development teams to design, onboard, and optimize DevOps toolchains such as GitLab, Artifactory, and SonarQube; develop project plans, facilitate meetings, maintain project documentation, and drive delivery within scope, schedule, and budget; analyze business requirements, performance metrics, and project risks; and act as a technology liaison between business stakeholders and engineering teams.

Qualifications

Required:
Bachelor's degree in information sciences, technology, computer science, or related field.
3+ years' experience in a consulting firm, working on large-scale technology transformation and modernization projects in the commercial sector in the strategy, growth and IT transformation space with a strong focus on technology.
2+ years' experience in IT project management, engineering transformation, and business analysis including tech modernization experience.
Demonstrated expertise in helping clients transform the SDLC to the AI SDLC using Claude, Claude Code and Cowork.
Project management-risk mitigation, RAID items, scheduling, cost control.
Stakeholder management-bridging business and engineering groups.
Data center and application migration projects.
Business intelligence, reporting (Power BI), and analytics delivery.
Demonstrated use of AI in current project environment.
Advanced proficiency with project management tools (Confluence, JIRA) and reporting in a consulting, financial services, or technology environment.
Experience evaluating the engineering toolchain and technical solutions approaches across programs with specific experience working on application development modernization projects on a large scale with a strategic as well as technical focus.
Strong presentation, communication, and customer service mindset; proven ability to develop strong client relationships and deliver results across geographically distributed teams.
Certifications: Certified Scrum Master, ITIL Foundation.
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:
Experience with large-scale technology modernization, cloud transformation, and continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline improvement.
Experience using transformation execution centers (TXC) and similar program execution platforms.
Claude certification(s).
Master's degree.
